Use case: precise-object-edit. Batch 65 Atlas A, nine requested GM revisions. The supplied sheet contains the EXACT selected revision targets in matching cells. Preserve each subject's useful silhouette and change the requested parts; cell 2 must be COMPLETELY REGENERATED because its pliers repeatedly failed. No copying the broken tool anatomy. Respect the nine distinct changes.
ONE complete SQUARE 3x3 atlas, exactly nine equal square cells in strict ROW-MAJOR order. One independent centered glyph per cell. The entire subject must fit inside the middle 60% of its cell, reserving at least 20% EMPTY margin on every side. Do not clip heads, hands, limbs, blades or vehicles. Pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF silhouettes on a pure solid BLACK #000000 background. Serious minimal flat utilitarian stencil shapes for dnd5e UI, broad functional forms and broad structural negative space, readable at 16/24/32 pixels. No grid lines, labels, lettering, logos, numbers, borders or watermark. No shading, gradients, grey fills, texture, distress, specks, scratches, hatching, gore or decorative badges. Believable adult anatomy, no cartoon gloves, toy proportions or oversized generic cogs. Each cell is separate; never let a shape enter its neighbor.
ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
1. samuraj_revision_d: Keep the exact selected katana and sword hand. Change ONLY the empty off hand: palm faces upward, fingers slightly curled toward the viewer in a clear beckoning 'come here' gesture. Thumb stays distinct from four fingers; exactly two adult hands and one katana. No scabbard.
2. bebeszenie_revision_d: Completely REGENERATE this tool composition instead of copying the broken pliers. One normal pair of combination pliers crosses one broad butcher knife below a small clean rib-cage outline. Pliers have exactly two continuous straight handles, one central pivot and two short coherent jaws; the handles are thick straight bars, not hooks or zigzags. Knife has one solid blade and one straight handle. Keep the two tools separated by a broad black cutout at the crossing. No hand, gore or extra tools.
3. szabrowanie_revision_d: Keep the open crate and its full-size raised lid. Draw one complete crowbar leaning diagonally BESIDE the crate, with its flattened hooked tip fully visible and a continuous broad BLACK GAP between the entire crowbar and crate/lid. Do not show contact with the crate; distinct non-touching silhouettes are essential. Only one crate and one crowbar.
4. chodzmy-na-pewno-juz-utonal_revision_c: Keep the swimmer's improved pelvis and exactly two legs, head, waterline and one air bubble. Restore the missing hand: exactly two naturally connected arms, each ending in one complete adult hand, swimming forward. Separate the forward hands with broad negative space. No amputated wrist, additional arm, fused hands or fins.
5. zjadlem-wlasnego-psa_revision_c: Move a little closer to the butcher's face while showing his whole uncropped BALD head, heavy beard, stern expression, apron shoulders and raised axe hand. Replace the backwards hatchet head with a normal hatchet: straight short haft, solid eye seated on the haft, broad axe blade projects outward away from the man's head with the cutting edge facing outward. Keep the blade and hand complete. No hair, clipped skull or gore.
6. barbarka_revision_b: Make the headbutt visibly ASYMMETRIC. Left attacker bends forward and drives his forehead into the right victim's nose; right victim's head tilts back and recoils. Only the attacker delivers the blow. Different head angles and postures, one restrained impact burst at the victim's nose, two intact heads. No mirrored forehead-to-forehead pose, blood or gore.
7. benzyna-zamiast-krwi_revision_b: Keep the driver gripping the steering wheel and the small protected car silhouette. Remove the seatbelt/diagonal torso strap completely. Change the driver's face to a wild menacing wide toothy grin with raised cheeks; a generic reckless wasteland driver, no recognizable game character or logo. Keep the head fully visible and the hands anatomically normal.
8. fachowiec_revision_b: Keep the mechanic with wrench in one hand and pliers in the other above the workbench. Both upper arms descend naturally from their own shoulders, elbows bend outward and forearms connect to exactly two complete hands. Position both hands and tools ABOVE the bench with a broad black gap between the bench and each hand/tool. No hands growing out of the tabletop, disconnected arms or extra tools.
9. jest-zajebiscie_revision_b: Preserve the speaker and two attentive allied head-and-shoulder silhouettes. Replace the raised open hand with one unambiguous THUMBS-UP: four fingers folded into a compact fist and one thumb pointing upward. Give the speaker a relaxed friendly smile and calm eyebrows. No pointing index finger, spread fingers, speech text or extra hand.
CRITICAL: cell 1 off-hand palm UP with curled beckoning fingers; cell 2 structurally intact straight-handled pliers, entirely redraw it; cell 3 crowbar and crate MUST NOT TOUCH anywhere; cell 4 exactly TWO complete hands plus TWO complete legs; cell 5 BALD bearded head and axe edge pointing outward; cell 6 asymmetric forehead-to-NOSE headbutt; cell 8 hands above and separate from bench; cell 9 THUMBS-UP and relaxed smile.

2. muzyk_revision_b: Keep the anonymous guitarist, plain acoustic guitar, left hand on the neck and right hand strumming. Replace ONLY the ambiguous lower-left blob with a clear audience member's head-and-shoulders silhouette, facing the musician and visibly separated by black space. 3. Padnij/Powstań: One practical survivor rises from a low kneel into a ready stance, with one knee near the ground, the other foot planted and both hands clear. A single complete body conveys getting up quickly; no duplicate ghost figures or arrows.

9. Przydasie: One adult hand selects a useful large bolt from a small open tray containing three distinct reusable scrap parts: bolt, metal bracket and wire coil. Real salvaged workshop pieces, one tray and one hand. No money symbols, giant cog or tiny clutter.
CRITICAL: cell 1 exactly two forearms and two hands in a plausible wrist grab, no extra guard pair. Cell 2 replace the bottom-left blob with one clearly recognizable audience head-and-shoulders. New cells must have broad simple silhouettes; no repeat of old sheet subjects.

3. Rozróba: One rugged fighter swings one short melee club through a broad arc between THREE nearby opposing head-and-shoulder silhouettes. One attacker, one club, three opponents spaced clearly around him. No duplicate attacker arms, gore or tiny motion lines.
4. Ruchome gniazdo CKM: One powerful survivor fires a heavy belt-fed machine gun from the hip, gripping the rear pistol grip and front support handle. 5. Siekierezada: Two adult hands hold TWO practical matching hatchets in crossed combat positions. Each hatchet has one straight short handle and one broad coherent axe head with cutting edge facing away from its user's hand. Exactly two hands and two hatchets; no third blade, ornate axes or gore.
6. Snajper: One prone anonymous marksman aims a long practical scoped rifle resting on a low bipod. Broad body contour, two connected hands, one scope tube and one long barrel. Plain gear, no floating target/crosshair, badge or tiny camouflage marks.

8. Szkolenie w broni: One learner's sturdy hands practice with a plain combat knife while an instructor's single guiding forearm points toward a solid training post. Clear knife blade, two learner hands and one instructor hand, no extra weapons, badges or text.
9. Szkolenie w ciężkim pancerzu: One practical trainee tightens a broad side strap on a heavy plate breastplate, with one hand drawing the strap and the other bracing a thick shoulder plate. Simple complete armour shape with massive plates, no face, fantasy ornament, logo or floating shield.
Keep anatomy and object counts physically coherent. Cell 1 is a generic archer without recognizable character styling. Exactly two hand-held hatchets in cell 5, one scoped rifle in cell 6. Keep the three-figure practice icon in cell 8 visually distinct from the two-hands-only icons.
